checks.name: amendment_accuracy_and_seals
checks.detail: The seal chain is structurally correct: PREREGISTRATION_SEAL.json (v1) cites this auditor's v1 receipt (sha 034fd922... verified) and was superseded with zero rows generated under it (gen.log shows FAIL combined 35 at generate_row.py:79 host>=0 assert, which fires before any output directory is created; rows/ does not exist); SEAL_ADDENDUM_ORCHESTRATOR.json (sha bb3a86d6..., matching the v2 seal's reference) covers the orchestrator scheduling revision 7299c2fb -> bcd17829 (the revised orchestrator, read in full, changes only job scheduling to rank-pairs and fixes the stale docstring); PREREGISTRATION_SEAL_v2.json binds every current sha (estimator 4ba5e4a2, generator d1484893, orchestrator bcd17829, builder 3c616b27, prereg 2e6ee889 - all recomputed and equal). The amendment's DIAGNOSIS is accurate and was reproduced exactly: the pre-clamp build emits 322 negative unit means, min -1.3039742043474689e-05, mean -3.1e-6 (40 in the final layer) on rank 35. THE FIX DOES NOT WORK: the projection was inserted at _predict's output stack, but the deployed path is Estimator.predict -> _predict_corrected, which computes host = _predict(...) THEN output = host + transport_correction - the learned correction is added AFTER the clamp. Instrumented run of the sealed 4ba5e4a2 build on rank 35: host at the clamp site has ZERO negatives (min +1.5e-17), so the clamp is a billed no-op (+32768 flops), the final output is bit-identical to the unclamped a746d46e build, still contains the same 322 negatives at min -1.30e-5, and the generator's (host >= 0).all() validation fails again identically. The amendment text's claims 'a final fnp.maximum(...,0.0) projection', 'reported means clamped at zero', and 'can only reduce MSE' are therefore false for the shipped build: the projection is not final, does not touch the reported means, and changes nothing but billing. Generation under this seal will fail at its first row.
